_comment: pa11y-ci configuration. Port 1315 is a placeholder: the PR CI workflow
rewrites it to a free port it allocated, and locally it matches
`hugo server --port 1315`. List the pages that represent each distinct
template rather than every page -- a template fixed once is fixed
everywhere. A per-URL `ignore` array documents a known, accepted failure;
keep the reason next to it or it becomes permanent by accident.
